entry.label: Distinction
entry.description: Distinctions make a world manageable enough for thought and action. They do not merely copy divisions already waiting in reality; they select, stabilise and test differences for a purpose.
entry.canonical_definition: A situated act of marking a difference so that one side can be indicated, discussed or acted upon; the distinction reveals some possibilities and leaves others unmarked.

profile.title: Distinction
profile.canonical_definition: A situated act of marking a difference so that one side can be indicated, discussed or acted upon; the distinction reveals some possibilities and leaves others unmarked.
profile.summary: Distinctions make a world manageable enough for thought and action. They do not merely copy divisions already waiting in reality; they select, stabilise and test differences for a purpose.
profile.why_it_matters: Every system map, category, KPI, service boundary and diagnosis begins with distinctions. Hidden distinctions are often more influential than explicit conclusions.
key_distinctions: difference noticed vs difference made consequential
logical_antecedents: an observer or system capable of indication
practice_connections: ask what difference is being marked
name what falls into the unmarked remainder
test whether another distinction changes action
avoid turning a convenient cut into a natural kind
common_misreadings: drawing more categories necessarily increases understanding
profile.editorial_note: Readable orientation and evidence-backed first pass. Named editorial review is still required before canonical acceptance.
